blurb: This check verifies the DISA STIG network-option tunables for IBM AIX 7.x: IP forwarding must be off (ipforwarding and ip6forwarding = 0), TCP half-open connection cleanup must be on (clean_partial_conns = 1), and broadcast ping must be off (bcastping = 0). Each tunable is read from 'no -a' and compared to its required value; a tunable left at the wrong value is a hardening gap an auditor will flag.
